# Furnisys

> Furnisys (Furniture Systems) is the industrial furniture brand of Fabtech India, based in Navi Mumbai, India. Tagline: "Functional Furniture Systems". Furnisys designs, manufactures and installs modular, configurable workspace systems (industrial workbenches, ESD workstations, modular workstations, storage cabinets, pegboards and steel lockers) for manufacturing plants, laboratories, automotive service centres, aerospace, healthcare, jewellery manufacturing and education. Every setup is built from standard modules so it can be expanded or reconfigured.

Key facts:
- Manufacturer: Fabtech India, EL-21, TTC Industrial Area, MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400710, India
- Manufacturing facility: 22,000 sq. ft. in Navi Mumbai
- Programs: Industrial System; Wall System; Lockers System
- Services: application consultancy, 2D/3D space planning, manufacturing, installation, after-sales service
- Contact: enquiry@furnisys.co (projects), bd@furnisys.co (channel partners), +91 70457 63012, Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00 IST
- Website: https://www.furnisys.co.in
